_readme: SocialSync guardrails for Pukeko Construction. 'facts' and 'forbidden_phrases' are ERRORS (they block scheduling) and mirror the verified facts in Trendi's truth.json. 'warnings' cover claims that are still pending verification: they are shown to the user but do not block. Edit this file at any time; the server reloads it automatically. Set TRUTH_JSON=/path/to/truth.json to merge the owner-verified facts from Trendi automatically.

facts.note: Posts may say 'more than/over 10 years'. Any other number after 'more than/over' is blocked.

warnings.message: The Nu-Wall relationship wording is not verified yet (owner says 'certified installer/representative', the website says 'preferred installer'). Confirm the exact term with Nu-Wall before posting.
Warranty and guarantee claims are not verified yet. Attribute manufacturer warranties to Nu-Wall and link their document; do not imply a separate Pukeko guarantee.
Product lifespan and finish-warranty figures belong to Nu-Wall. Check their current wording and attribute it to them.
Conrad is Deaf and leads come by text, email or the quote form. Replace the phone call-to-action with one of those.
The LBP licence number has not been verified yet. Do not quote it until the owner confirms it.
Memberships and accreditations are not verified yet. Only name ones the owner has confirmed in writing.
Pukeko's pricing and quoting policy has not been confirmed. Do not publish prices or ranges yet.
Typical project timelines have not been provided yet. Avoid stating how long a job takes.
Superlatives need proof (reviews, awards) that we do not have yet. Consider a factual statement instead.
